# 💥 Powers
 [Clone Conjuration](item_6c9f6be1-ab29-4f46-af24-34e4835f9af3) allows you to summon a clone with Swift Step, and it can heal and deal damage, albeit a lot weaker. It's not going to be that impactful yet at this stage, but it's still quite useful to start with it since the clone can help with healing and saving allies.

---

# 🎮 Playstyle
Have Kiriko's clone spawn as often as possible during team fights, but with caution; pay attention to cooldown and your teleport target's location as you could be vulnerable and become easy target. Try to deal damage at long range. Play safe in this round.

# 🛠️ Items:
## ✔️ Sufficient cash
- [Icy Coolant](item_8b1c21e9-33e8-49a6-8277-a3a06d55a65f) - Increases [Cooldown Reduction](stat_cooldown_reduction) and [Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power).
- [Multi-Tool](item_5ba8d94e-f2f3-44b7-8773-025fc6ed7c56) - Increases [Ability Power](stat_ability_power) and [Cooldown Reduction](stat_cooldown_reduction).
- [Iridescent Iris](item_b7fb28ef-ce82-416b-8693-01c274f8df4e) - If you have enough cash, get this instead of  [Multi-Tool](item_5ba8d94e-f2f3-44b7-8773-025fc6ed7c56). More [Cooldown Reduction](stat_cooldown_reduction) and [Ability Power](stat_ability_power).
## ❌ Insufficient cash
- Prioritize [Multi-Tool](item_5ba8d94e-f2f3-44b7-8773-025fc6ed7c56).
- Get [Ability Power](stat_ability_power) item(s) you can afford.

---

# 🛡️ Survivability
📌 Only if *absolutely* necessary. Sacrifice [Icy Coolant](item_8b1c21e9-33e8-49a6-8277-a3a06d55a65f) if need be.

- [Cushioned Padding](item_20f2f4bc-4611-4d1f-b653-20f04d56b96f) - Against heroes that limit abilities (Mei, Cassidy, Ashe, Ana, etc.)
- [Iron Eyes](item_f16d03a7-f20e-4a1d-a1f6-55863e163c03) - Against Genji on "Melee" build.
- [Reinforced Titanium](item_8ebaa7db-aedf-48ed-adc1-318cb46a3214) - Against heroes on [Ability Power](stat_ability_power) build (Juno, Soldier, D.Va, etc.)
- [Crusader Hydraulics](item_b64cee07-ca32-405d-987e-868b415bbc09) - Against heroes on [Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power) build (Orisa, Zarya, Reaper, etc.)

️Keep this item onward, or at least until you think you don't need it anymore. You might need to give up an essential item, but it is more important to stay alive.

---

# 🎮 Playstyle
Play similarly to last round, but maybe less passively. You could focus more on dealing damage by taking off angles.

# 💥 Powers
 [Two-Zu](item_80f16d3e-a4c0-4fa8-90b1-a0f033a1a77b) adds another charge to Suzu, meaning you have two Suzus at hand. This increases the survivability for yourself and allies, especially with the item [Talisman of Life](item_7ecfd3eb-d869-41fe-87eb-0bb2e82e5718).

---

# 🛠️ Items
## ✔️ Sufficient cash
- [Talisman of Life](item_7ecfd3eb-d869-41fe-87eb-0bb2e82e5718) - Gives allies 100 Overhealth with Suzu. Really good item that keeps team alive.
- [Iridescent Iris](item_b7fb28ef-ce82-416b-8693-01c274f8df4e) - If you have extra cash. More [Cooldown Reduction](stat_cooldown_reduction) and [Ability Power](stat_ability_power).
- Add [Multi-Tool](item_5ba8d94e-f2f3-44b7-8773-025fc6ed7c56) if possible. Increases [Ability Power](stat_ability_power) and [Cooldown Reduction](stat_cooldown_reduction).

## ❌ Insufficient cash
- Prioritize [Talisman of Life](item_7ecfd3eb-d869-41fe-87eb-0bb2e82e5718).
- [Multi-Tool](item_5ba8d94e-f2f3-44b7-8773-025fc6ed7c56) instead of [Icy Coolant](item_8b1c21e9-33e8-49a6-8277-a3a06d55a65f). Gives [Ability Power](stat_ability_power) and [Cooldown Reduction](stat_cooldown_reduction).
- If you can't even afford [Multi-Tool](item_5ba8d94e-f2f3-44b7-8773-025fc6ed7c56), get [Custom Stock](item_17d633af-8bcc-4893-b865-be0a7bc66fe2).

## 📌 Note
Even though [Talisman of Life](item_7ecfd3eb-d869-41fe-87eb-0bb2e82e5718) gives [Ability Power](stat_ability_power) instead of [Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power), it increases your team's chance of survival by a whole lot, especially now with two Suzus. I find Round 3 more winnable when Kiriko provides the team with survivability than when she has higher damage output because it's usually the round where players finally get good items and can turn things around. Either way, dealing damage should be manageable since you have the clone helping out with heals.

# 🎮 Playstyle
With 25% [Cooldown Reduction](stat_cooldown_reduction), Swift Step can summon the clone with 76% uptime — this means after the clone's duration ends, you can summon it again around 1 second later. Use Swift Step every time you can during team fights now that the clone can keep up with the ability's cooldown. Your team should be quite hard to eliminate, but you should still pray they don't feed or make stupid decisions.

Try to make the best of [Foxy Fireworks](item_d29ac7bb-d84c-44d7-8944-24c9b668b657) by spamming and reloading whenever you can to maintain that explosive perk. It also can deal with enemies that come close pretty well.

Now that you're on the full build, you should be able to keep your allies alive while applying immense pressure with kunais. Your team should feel undefeatable at this point, so if you find them dying often despite trying your very best to save them, it's probably not your fault.
